articles.title: OKX, MetaMask, Matter Labs back dispute resolution court for AI agents
articles.snippet: The Genlayer Foundation is leading the 27-firm consortium that makes AI-based payments, escrow and dispute resolution interoperable.

articles.title: Polymarket seeks approval to bring margin trading to U.S. customers
articles.snippet: Polymarket's application to allow users to take positions that are not fully collateralized follows authorization granted to rival Kalshi in March.

articles.title: Backpack joins race for 24/7 stock markets with tokenized equities
articles.snippet: The launch comes as tokenized stocks become one of the fastest-growing corners of crypto, with exchanges and traditional finance firms racing to expand 24/7 trading.

articles.title: Wall Street banks tighten prediction market rules for staff as insider fears spread
articles.snippet: Wall Street banks, including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, are restricting employee prediction market trades as insider trading fears spread across Polymarket and Kalshi.

articles.title: AI Agents Could Be Turned Into Botnets Through Hallucinations, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: Researchers warn AI agents could be tricked into downloading malicious code by exploiting the same hallucinations that cause chatbots to make mistakes.
